facts.fact: 沙发共读（companionable silence 五分钟）遇美式同龄 bibliophile；罗马地图课：Piazza della Minerva 的《象与方尖碑》（mad-bad-great 的 Bernini）——象＝教廷符号、教廷永恒因扛得动埃及方尖碑（endurance 之符）——但「雕像的意图从不保证与观者解读重合」；St Peter's 广场方尖碑来自 Alexandria、Caligula 时代运来（多数人只看大殿立面不看它）；他首次访罗马——「grandeur 与 intimacy 双杀」；「You look familiar」→maybe in a previous life；派对上至少九个澳洲人（Xavier Australophile＋Brisbane 前妻＋五本澳洲小说意译）；「mad-bad Aussie」＝Martin——他亲眼看到 patio 上 Martin 打断书评人鼻子。
facts.anchor: a statue’s intended meaning is never guaranteed to coincide with a viewer’s interpretation

facts.fact: Martin 三十年档案：少年时代相识、同龄、橄榄球与板球对队对手、双双当记者、路径 crisscross 三十年——「too aggressive and too argumentative, though he does have a sensitive side」；意版《Lost in the Bush》差评→punch Frederico（血溅 Hawaiian 衫）；此书＝Australian style 历史小说、simply written verging on melodrama（不合叙述者口味但卖得好、法国出版获好评）；Chip 目击 90 年代中酒馆拳战——起因是诗（「blank verse vs rhyming ballad?」——nineteenth-century behaviour）；吸烟忏悔（dirty filthy habit、喝酒才抽）。
facts.anchor: Martin punched the reviewer – a charming guy called Frederico – and broke his nose

facts.fact: 墨尔本宜居课：Economist 说墨尔本与 Vancouver 并列全球最宜居——NYC 是「most entertaining but most unliveable」（他与妻子都对纽约爱恨交加）；妻子最后通牒：欧洲两周后举家搬 Sydney 或 Vancouver；墨尔本「can be charming, can be quaint, can be dull」；杂志编辑在 Pellegrini's 午餐上断言墨尔本天下第一——却没去过巴黎罗马伦敦纽约、除澳洲只去过 Bali；Chip 双重身份：两部 literary novels 卖不动、白昼工作出版 commercial fiction 卖爆——罗马两日散步后决意辞职自办出版社、举家搬出美国（Upper West Side 两居室→要买得起 house）；机密计划：复刻 1961 年《The Executive Coloring Book》（三位广告人所作、黑白线稿配说明涂色）出版成人涂色书——市场逻辑：人人盯屏幕伤眼、涂色书回到 simpler time＋relieve 眼睛＋a modicum of creativity；荣格疗法背书：让病人画曼陀罗涂色以 relax 神经系统、achieve wholeness。
facts.anchor: You would have to say Melbourne is the greatest city in the world

facts.fact: Chip 的新书＝1900–1910 早期电影史（想写能赚钱的书）——澳洲连接：第一部全时长故事片（70 分钟）＝1906 年澳洲《The Story of the Kelly Gang》；修复版的 nitrate 损坏帧（half-images/quarter-images/blur）最有味；曾在部分澳洲州被禁（glorifying bushrangers）；他对插画小说黄金时代（1830s–1860s 英法）如数家珍：《Pickwick Papers》原是配图委托——「the illustrator was the star, and Dickens was the support act」、杂志驱动的图文饥渴；叙述者报 Tenniel（Alice）与 Doré（神曲）、自己出版过插画 gift book（star author＝Janis Joplin 打扮的 unloved waif——Chip 遇过她：问自助餐哪个是 vegan、然后 babble on about herself）；Chip 旅行史贫瘠（加拿大、墨西哥、首次欧洲）；32% 的美国人有护照。
facts.anchor: Do you know The Story of the Kelly Gang?

facts.fact: Chip 的姓名学：受洗名 Charles（Chip/Chipper/Chuck/Chas；姐妹 Charlene 与 Charlotta 叫他 Chipster/Chuckles；妻子叫他 a Chip Off the Old Blockhead——娶她因幽默）；妻子 Caroline＝孪生妹妹 Carolina（拉出洗碗机水管淹了公寓来暂住；背影 identical——他从背后搂错过人）；「as jokey as her twin is sour, as warm-hearted as her twin is malevolent, as blessed as her twin is blighted」；孩子 Posy 与 Maisie；澳洲绰号课（Larry→Lazza、Marion→Mazza、John→Johno）；「Charles＝free man」——对我更该是 indentured slave（rat race 的 fully paid-up 会员）；Boston Brahmin 家族（父系荷兰、母系爱尔兰）与「shirtsleeves to shirtsleeves in three generations」定律：曾祖兄弟创业、祖父与父亲「deluded but amiable numbskulls」散尽遗产（incompetence＋lavish spending）；第四代有 entitlement 无 backing——祖先如 smug ghosts 在画像上冷笑；姐妹拿古董家具与珠宝、他拿三十幅画；真 Old Master 已在大萧条卖光——余下多是从荷兰 junk shops 捡的 Rembrandt/Hals 冒牌（或学徒摹本）；无名荷兰黄金时代风俗画现值 3–8 千刀（叙述者猜 10–15k）——「the value of art is only what someone is prepared to pay」。
facts.anchor: like the great moment in 1881 when a collector bought Girl with a Pearl Earring

facts.fact: Vermeer 狂热家史：Vermeer mania＝tulip mania 的变体（父系遗传）——great joy 与 maddening suffering 兼有；父亲曾想买高品质 Van Meegeren 伪作未遂（他暗爽）；fin de siècle 的导火索＝1881 年海牙小拍卖行 2.5 盾（今约 35 刀）购得《Girl with a Pearl Earring》；五到九岁每个生日父亲请假带他去 Isabella Stewart Gardner Museum 只看两幅：Vermeer《The Concert》与伦勃朗《Storm on the Sea of Galilee》——他每次选伦勃朗（dramatic）令父失望（成年后 Vermeer 忠诚继承才启动）；1990 年 St Patrick's Day 两幅同被盗走、至今未见；母亲玩笑：父亲（stockbroker、inept businessman、good man 已故）每年歇这天反而是好事；他去世的母亲是 laugh-a-minute 的 endless talking machine；盗窃后父子去看空画框「patiently waiting for the missing paintings to return」——「the thieves had stolen part of his childhood」；叙述者一周前在 Louvre 误入无人展厅：满墙只剩画框「似乎遭了抢却无人察觉」——So resonant；Bergotte 死亡场景：普鲁斯特《追忆》中小说家赶去看《View of Delft》的「little patch of yellow wall」、坐圆椅歇晕、栽地而死；Chip 读《The Pickwick Papers》（effervescent、插画做 heavy lifting）。
facts.anchor: The Concert and the Storm on the Sea of Galilee

facts.fact: 9/11 双证词：叙述者上周四巴黎飞罗马邻座曼哈顿人＝世贸旁咖啡馆店员、第一批 responders（给裹满 ash/debris 的逃生者送水）——他反复用的词是 incomprehensible；Chip 当时住 Hoboken——早上找不到钱包迟到、打电话请病假——从俯瞰 Hudson 的公寓窗前 front-row 目击；楼里邻居用 Super 8 拍下「我见过的最惊人的 9/11 影像」——「Hitchcock technicolour images from the 1950s」、黑白剧照如 Seurat 素描；他随身带几张当书签——交出三张彩色照片（Hoboken 望曼哈顿、两栋燃烧高楼黑烟）；「sun glinting off one of the skyscrapers」在他 Vermeer 满格的眼里＝《View of Delft》的对位；「time has been stopped still」→「History itself was stopped still by September 11」；serenity vs tragedy；纽约人至今未愈、每个在场者都有故事；墨尔本之行盘算（咖啡好、机票贵、NYC→LA 六小时＋转机两小时＋悉尼十四小时、Melbourne 离一切很远只除新西兰）；Antipodeans 宣传画笑谈（倒挂抓地的地球底部居民）——「My family might enjoy living upside down for a while」。
facts.anchor: I had a front-row seat to the unfolding nightmare

facts.fact: 终场出逃：Chiara 领来 Giselle（把澳洲小说译成法语）——她童年梦想澳洲（五岁时父母离婚、澳洲 au pair Riley 比父母更 present and emotionally available、带来 hard-to-believe 动物图画书：kangaroo/koala/platypus/echidna/wombat；澳夏之行「surprised me, but it didn't disappoint me」）——Katy 中断：I've had enough of this party. We must leave, and we must leave now——本是 best party in a long time、突然 tiresome（like a switch had been thrown：所有人都在 harass 她）；清单：Martin 求欢（if she was up for it—— politely declined、把她逼进墙角才逃脱；衬衫上 wine＋blood）；Smyg 缠她当 ghost-writer（自称专攻 firemen 但太 flighty、改攻 rock musicians）；连 good-natured Xavier 都搂她「looked cold」请上卧室看 etchings（婉拒）——「I feel beset upon」；她propriorial 地挽住他的胳膊（like we were an old married couple）；告别：Chip 记下电话号、Chiara、Smyg（巴黎见）；谢过 Xavier 的 marvellous and memorable party（受邀明年再来——do our very best）；走出照片走廊时他想：还会回到 Xavier 的仲夏派对吗？
facts.anchor: We must leave, and we must leave now
